topic: 4.1 Component 2: Reading and Writing
outcome: Read two passages in Urdu dealing with related themes (together not exceeding 750 words, written during the last twenty years and reflecting the international scene), using Urdu for all questions and answers.

topic: 4.1 Component 2: Reading and Writing
outcome: On the first passage, answer two tests (5 marks each) covering vocabulary recognition and grammatical manipulation.

topic: 4.1 Component 2: Reading and Writing
outcome: On the first passage, answer a series of comprehension questions (15 marks for Content and 5 marks for Quality of Language).

topic: 4.1 Component 2: Reading and Writing
outcome: On the second passage, answer a series of comprehension questions (15 marks for Content and 5 marks for Quality of Language).

topic: 4.1 Component 2: Reading and Writing
outcome: Write about 140 words drawing information from both passages and adding your own opinions, as a summary or comparison of issues raised (10 marks for information from the passages, 5 for personal response, 5 for Quality of Language).

topic: 4.2 Component 3: Essay
outcome: Choose one of five questions, one set on each of the five set topics, and write an essay in Urdu of 250–400 words.

topic: 4.2 Component 3: Essay
outcome: Know that of the 40 marks, 24 are for the quality of the language and 16 for the content.
